conditioning: Fresh engine per group; code, four strict 24K warmups, 100 actual short tool completions in every lane, then measurement
selection_rule: Record joint short P95, long latency, throughput and actual policy. Freeze all three qualified lanes for independent formal comparison; retain both absolute and own-solo-relative costs. Zero-hysteresis crossover is reconstructed from actual inputs, not another performance run.
scope: Two frozen full128K cold/resume mixed groups, 24 short at .5RPS over48s and one long at16s; no SOTA ceiling claim
